text:
Alex H: Heads up — putting a proposal together for how we package/send Redwood Optimize quant profiles. Want feedback on naming + minimal manifest for runtime + rollout metadata.

Anika S: nice. high-level goals?

Alex H: keep it small, machine-parseable, versioned, and runtime-safe. Need fields for model, quant backend, hardware hints, accuracy delta, and rollout tags.

Tyler P: agree. also compatibility constraints (runtime semver) and verification checks (smoke eval id).

Jordana L: can we standardize on semver for profile version? e.g. 1.0.0 where minor bump = non-breaking param changes, major = format changes

Mia R: propose file name pattern: <model>__<quant>__<hw>__v<semver>.qprofile.yaml

Alex H: example manifest:
```
name: llama-3-70b__awq-int8__a100-80gb__v1.0.0
model: llama-3-70b
quant: awq-int8
hw_target: a100-80gb
profile_version: "1.0.0"
compat: 
  runtime: ">=2.5.0"
metrics:
  perf: {latency_ms: 12.3, throughput_rps: 18}
  accuracy: {eval: 'winoground', delta: -0.7}
tags: ["optimize:canary","latency-optimized"]
checksum: "sha256:..."
```

Anika S: love checksum + runtime constraint. add `quant_variant` for gptq/awq/fp8. also `fallback_model` optional.

Tyler P: for naming, avoid colons and spaces. use dashes or double-underscore. Also we should normalize quant names: awq-int8 -> awq/int8? maybe stick with awq-int8 for simplicity.

Jordana L: validation command:
```
rwd-optimize validate ./profiles/llama3-awq-v1.qprofile.yaml
```
should check schema, checksum, smoke eval within tolerance.

Mia R: rollout metadata idea: `rollout: {strategy: canary, percent: 5, monitor: 'latency,accuracy'}`

Alex H: how to express accuracy regressions? `metrics.accuracy.delta` as float (pct) + `tolerance` field.

Anika S: add `stability: experimental|stable|deprecated`

Tyler P: minor nit — include `created_by` and `created_at` for audit.

Alex H: next steps: I'll draft a RFC doc + add JSON schema for CI. If no objections I'll land basic schema in repo and wire `rwd-optimize` to validate on PRs.

Jordana L: +1 from me. can we include a migration guide for consumers when profile major versions change?

Mia R: i'll make a quick PR with naming lints and a generator script for packagers.

profile-bot: new profile uploaded: llama-3-70b__gptq-int8__rtx6000__v0.1.0 — validation: failed (accuracy delta -2.1% > tolerance 1.0%)

Alex H: perfect test. shows we need clearer consumer docs and default tolerances per workload.

Anika S: can we add an "alert_on_fail" field so Optimize can auto-block deployments?

Alex H: yes — will add rollout.alert_on_fail: true|false

Tyler P: thanks — this is great. keeping naming compact will help logs and S3 keys.

Alex H: ok closing for now — will post RFC link once I open it. :rocket:
